title: Cosmic Bird and Golden Egg
description: A vibrant blue and purple bird with iridescent rainbow wings perches on a gnarled branch, looking upward toward a golden beam of light. Below the branch rests a large ornate golden egg nestled in glowing golden ginkgo leaves, set against a deep blue and purple cosmic background filled with swirling spiral patterns and stars.
prompt: A luminous blue and turquoise bird with rainbow iridescent wings perched on a dark branch, looking toward a golden light beam from above. A large ornate golden egg with intricate spiral patterns rests in glowing golden ginkgo leaves directly below. Deep cosmic blue and purple background filled with glowing swirls, stars, and magical particles, vibrant fantasy style, rich detail and luminous colors.
